scope: HSB trial for Alpha, Beta, Unlimited and Revised. Separate frame material, rules paper and mana-disc diagnostics. Frozen metadata-based cohorts, with identical name ordering across sets. Ten printings per available material, or all when fewer; half reserved. Sparse basic-land groups remain explicitly low-confidence. No per-scan color or geometric fit; original assets and art retained. Full-card previews use Oracle wording with original symbols; no typography certification.
